purpose: Anticipate a hard fall impact up to one second before it lands, from the phone accelerometer.

dataset.name: UniMiB SHAR
dataset.citation: Micucci, D., Mobilio, M., Napoletano, P. (2017). UniMiB SHAR: A Dataset for Human Activity Recognition Using Acceleration Data from Smartphones. arXiv:1611.07688v2.

risk_bands.rule: HIGH = threshold maximising F1 on the validation split; MODERATE = largest threshold with validation recall >= 0.95, capped at HIGH

feature_definitions.name: acc_mag_mean
feature_definitions.label: Average force on the phone

feature_definitions.name: acc_mag_std
feature_definitions.label: How much the force is changing

feature_definitions.name: acc_mag_min
feature_definitions.label: Lightest moment (near zero = free fall)

feature_definitions.name: acc_mag_max
feature_definitions.label: Hardest moment in the last second

feature_definitions.name: acc_mag_range
feature_definitions.label: Spread between lightest and hardest moment

feature_definitions.name: acc_mag_energy
feature_definitions.label: Overall movement energy

feature_definitions.name: acc_mag_peak_jerk
feature_definitions.label: Suddenness of the sharpest change

feature_definitions.name: acc_mag_zcr
feature_definitions.label: How quickly the force is oscillating
feature_definitions.formula: count of sign changes of (magnitude - mean(magnitude))

feature_definitions.label: Average tilt on the x axis

feature_definitions.name: acc_y_mean
feature_definitions.label: Average tilt on the y axis

feature_definitions.name: acc_z_mean
feature_definitions.label: Average tilt on the z axis

feature_definitions.name: acc_x_std
feature_definitions.label: x-axis wobble

feature_definitions.name: acc_y_std
feature_definitions.label: y-axis wobble

feature_definitions.name: acc_z_std
feature_definitions.label: z-axis wobble

feature_definitions.name: acc_xy_corr
feature_definitions.label: How x and y move together
feature_definitions.formula: Pearson correlation of ax and ay (0 when either is constant)

feature_definitions.name: acc_xz_corr
feature_definitions.label: How x and z move together
feature_definitions.formula: Pearson correlation of ax and az

feature_definitions.name: acc_yz_corr
feature_definitions.label: How y and z move together
feature_definitions.formula: Pearson correlation of ay and az

feature_definitions.name: freefall_fraction
feature_definitions.label: Share of the second spent in free fall
feature_definitions.formula: share of samples with magnitude < 0.5 g

feature_definitions.name: tilt_deg
feature_definitions.label: How the phone is oriented
feature_definitions.formula: angle between the mean acceleration vector and the device z axis

feature_definitions.name: orientation_change_deg
feature_definitions.label: How much the phone rotated during the second
feature_definitions.formula: angle between the mean vector of the first and second half

feature_definitions.name: acc_mag_slope
feature_definitions.label: Whether the force is building or fading
feature_definitions.formula: least-squares slope of the magnitude against the sample index

feature_definitions.name: acc_mag_late_to_early_ratio
feature_definitions.label: Second half vs first half of the second
feature_definitions.formula: mean(magnitude in last quarter) / mean(magnitude in first quarter)

insufficient_data.reason: fewer samples than a full window, or an implausible magnitude from a misbehaving driver
